title: Public expression of support for the bill extending municipal police powers
description: On 5 February 2026 Koenders published a video backing a bill then debated in the Senate to extend the prerogatives of municipal police (including powers such as fining for drug use, driving without a licence and illegal street vending, plus wider use of drones and body cameras). The stance, consistent with her security portfolio, drew public criticism from the local La France insoumise collective.
status: position taken / national bill in debate

title: Withdrawal of animal-protection delegation from a majority councillor (municipal order)
description: By a municipal order (arrete) dated 25 February 2026, replacing the order of 20 December 2024, Mayor Koenders withdrew the animal-protection delegation from councillor Fabien Robert after his rapprochement with National Rally representatives on animal welfare, redefining the delegations of her majority.
